summary: Minors of the rescaled frame matrix are those of Z(γ) times frame scales.

steps.claim: frameDisc(1, Z(ratToInf(γ)_v)) is real and equals (∏_a frameScaleSq)²·Φ_v(𝗀(γ)): the minors of Z(ratToInf(γ)_v) are those of Z(γ) times products of frame scales (det_submatrix_realFrameGram_ratToInf), the determinant carrying ∏_{a≤ϱ} frameScaleSq and D_ϱ carrying ∏_{a<ϱ}, the scale of z (1/N) turning N²|D_ϱ|² into the matching term; and Φ_v(𝗀(γ)) = |Φ_v(𝗀(γ))| (map_termDisc_eq_norm).
steps.lean:
Fin 𝔰.n, S.frameScaleSq v a) ^ 2 * ‖Φ v (S.termDisc γ)‖ := congrArg _ (by simp [↓ofReal_mul,
  ↓← map_termDisc_eq_norm, leadingMinor, ↓det_submatrix_realFrameGram_ratToInf, frameScaleSq,
  prod_univ_add, pow_add, field] : frameDisc 1 ((realFrameGram _).submatrix id id) = ofReal _)
